parts.name: Lock
parts.Basic_description: This is the lock of the suitcase, typically made of metal for durability and security.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the suitcase by fastening the lid to the base, preventing accidental opening and providing protection for the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It can move through a latch or clasp mechanism, allowing it to open and close when operated.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the suitcase, made of durable plastic or rubber for comfortable carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase easily, providing a secure grip.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot slightly or remain fixed depending on the design, but is primarily used for manual lifting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the suitcase, typically made of leather or synthetic material for structure and aesthetics.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the primary storage compartment, protecting and containing the items inside.
parts.Movement_description: It is a rigid or semi-rigid structure that does not move independently but supports the other components.
